f501221327b9c59b583f.text: Enjoy the rest of your day.

abf8df174afd4ecabb59.text: I'll be there in ten minutes.

e4ac7ab1fe81726d24ce.text: No problem. Anything else? We have fresh banana bread.

caa2a51f65ad849f080d.text: You got it. It'll be ready in a minute.

e39ebba15c6c2a8c746f.text: That sounds nice, actually. I've been so tired this week.

d6109dfbe59866fefaa8.text: Same here. What about you? Are you going anywhere?

5a5fd1e99ffac57ef929.text: My sister wants to go hiking if the weather's good.

10a9bb1c7bf5d6ee1769.text: I heard it's going to rain on Saturday.

64c3bc2e0ab8d0ffacee.text: Then maybe we'll just get lunch and walk around the park.

41b7f525b58142326fe8.text: That still sounds pretty good. Tell me how it goes.

6cef944889b1bf85615a.text: I will. Have a good one.

cf547cb19128426d0a79.text: Sure. I finished the draft last night. I'll send it out after this call.

2380c0be240d084e4683.text: I still need the numbers from finance. I emailed them yesterday.

fd05df518f119ccd7e88.text: I can poke them if you want. I have a meeting with them at ten.

5e09c2dd08cc2f7046bb.text: I'm working on the fix. I should have something to show by tomorrow.

a82ae9cc8e13917538c5.text: Okay. Let's talk again if anything gets stuck.

fe2e21ff5123da108430.text: You're still here? It's almost nine.

9e3e9a6f73201a96d9ef.text: I know. I just want to finish this one thing.

36747accd3832a5f06e3.text: That's what you said an hour ago.

f08fd581ee5a8e1480d6.text: Yeah, well. It always takes longer than I think.

5a7b7f6b01182821df42.text: You should go home. It'll still be here in the morning.

ec4d2174fa0c38a67a0e.text: You're probably right. I'm just tired of seeing it undone.

9804a7cf6dc8115a910a.text: I get that. But you're not going to do your best work like this.

9d9671bb0013179ea7a5.text: Okay, okay. Let me save this and I'll walk out with you.

0ab3149b5b3c26546a85.text: Good. I'll wait by the elevator.

b1e803204d384d858431.text: Excuse me, could you help me for a second?

33bf0466a672e8811e39.text: I'm trying to get to the city library. Is it far from here?

5c6186b4b23133f8249a.text: Not really. Go straight for two blocks, then turn left at the lights.

de4bcfb5c9c4736c0724.text: After that, you'll see a park. The library is right across from it.

ae59f88dceedd941c87d.text: Across from the park. Got it. Thanks so much.

9f08149a87e55775b21b.text: No problem. You'll be there in about ten minutes.

04cce11d4c1f3c339a4c.text: Hey, Nina. I didn't know you shopped here.

9ae0b6265596b9334e0c.text: I usually come on weeknights. It's quieter.

4cd398e170ea2d4f2fca.text: Smart. I'm just grabbing a few things for dinner.

68ed541b06fc10aa318b.text: I don't know yet. Something simple. Pasta, maybe.

5c7a5cdf6508218e3174.text: The tomatoes look pretty good today, if you want a hint.

cfba19cf30bcab30a047.text: I'll take it. Do you know where they keep the olive oil?

ec99d996425a6a52373a.text: Aisle six, I think, next to the vinegar.

603505a106c567145bd5.text: Good morning, Riverside Clinic. How can I help you?

11c4674313d5ddfe0b2a.text: Hi, I'd like to make an appointment with Dr. Chen, please.

0110a525f042299acfa2.text: Sure. Have you seen her before?

107c61fc8156cff6be4f.text: Yes, I was there last March.

9c2cab60d2d9e2b394df.text: Okay. What's a good day for you this week?

17f31be67c2759814296.text: Thursday afternoon would be great, if she has anything open.

d6759064ba2345197b0d.text: I have a slot at three thirty. Does that work?

7d32ffc41d4bd64f6295.text: You're all set. Please come in ten minutes early.

0741a6ebe4afdc2d92be.text: It's really coming down out there.

5cebe1f973b995aaf944.text: I know. I didn't bring an umbrella, of course.

b46a41b72e6e36322485.text: I have an extra one in my bag, if you want to borrow it.

d6488c900ff3496a3287.text: Are you sure? I can just wait it out.

b4700cdef829876716fb.text: Take it. I walk to the station, so I always pack one.

9302aea08990a6db510f.text: Thanks. I'll bring it back tomorrow.

e08d47c1075464500f74.text: No rush. They said it's going to be like this all week.

12972daeb90f2ffc502d.text: Hey, at least it's not snow.

079e47b823055652bece.text: Hey, is this a good time?

700469edfd5c5061b559.text: Yeah, I just left work. What's going on?

871d08e4f54d363db502.text: Nothing urgent. I just wanted to hear how you're doing.

6db790baec7ca9147b5c.text: That's sweet. I'm okay, just a little worn out.

443ffd0eaceaaa28bd32.text: Want to get dinner this week? Nothing fancy.

13c07197791d16f1c160.text: I'd love that. Wednesday or Thursday works for me.

f1c6594c3d976a38f83d.text: Let's do Thursday. I'll find a place and text you.

1020aabdeeeac70b883d.text: Me too. Go get some rest.

14a366161de0d7b48289.text: So this is the living room. You get a lot of light in the afternoon.

4151e5d56e3b01c0c595.text: It's nicer than the photos, actually. How old is the building?

c6952b746439534d26cc.text: About fifteen years. The kitchen was redone last year.

ee8a9403bf36704ec312.text: That's good to know. Is the laundry in the unit?

b10157dfdd9b2f36ee99.text: It's on the same floor, just down the hall.

b969579d786dca3979ae.text: Okay. And is the rent including water and internet?

8076b40bdb86f66ea95a.text: Water yes, internet no. You'd set that up yourself.

158981e411e19e0b1270.text: Got it. I need to think it over, but I like it.

ff80fd71adb9876ca689.text: Of course. Let me know by Friday if you can.

db3385e469c0647d009d.text: I didn't expect to see you here so early.

e6314c4ca4c548c2a198.text: I know. I'm trying to come before work this month.

0579222f87ea0935c181.text: It's hard to get out of bed, but I feel better once I'm here.

bf13a3af07b9ca649f62.text: That's usually how it works. Are you doing a class?

b24820299486e7ff7e0d.text: Just a short run and some stretching. I don't want to overdo it.

66a8595425585b24ab8e.text: Smart. I went too hard last week and I'm still sore.

4dcca05dbc455bad3db7.text: Then maybe take it easy today.

8b6813ad72ccbf8718e2.text: Can you cut the onions? I'll start the rice.

935b770fd0e28ed5ce3a.text: Sure. How small do you want them?

ba97c64db5eafae8fa51.text: Check the bowl near the stove. There should be two cloves.

20cede2933c85fe343da.text: Found them. Should I add the tomatoes now?

32dcae38394ca3342596.text: Give the onions another minute. Then yes.

60a26cf575082d84b5f8.text: That's the idea. We'll eat in twenty minutes.

1c4620f9739d5831b18b.text: Do you have a minute? I wanted to ask about next Thursday.

67e25f93b08fc5cd4a17.text: I need to take that afternoon off. I have a family appointment.

f020338e9c4bdb8c87bd.text: That should be fine. Is the report going to be ready before then?

79cb5f1f83a8412e156f.text: Yes. I'll send it on Wednesday, and Leo can cover the call.

4886327071e851c03853.text: Okay, great. Just put it on the calendar so everyone can see.

9bad5f1d66312d1e255c.text: I will. Thanks for being flexible.

d97beb5afc2b20aed7dc.text: No problem. I hope everything goes well.

9d5063fcdbfa27b360d9.text: I'll be honest. We're not going to hit Friday.

2ebbfa1712929445f4de.text: I was worried about that. What's the main holdup?

e5bad8d62e32dcf08c26.text: The test results came back late, and we found two more issues.

4a1dd7cb78f860c8aa81.text: How much time do we actually need?

f144c590d9b2a04ee2f6.text: If we focus, maybe until Tuesday. I don't want to promise Monday.

0617a1635d2ed3b19d5f.text: Then we should tell the client today, not Friday.

55c7f68671802b01e3cb.text: I agree. Better to be early and clear.

a50f0a95cd0daebfb7a1.text: Okay. I'll send a note this afternoon and suggest Tuesday.

ea54957a7d7a5f42f930.text: Thanks. Let us know if you want help writing it.

ed18229e1ff45baf8e54.text: If we leave Friday night, we can have two full days there.

19a461ba7c80870b41ac.text: That works for me. Do you want to take the train or drive?

fde19682f2772ca8d5bc.text: The train is easier. I don't want to worry about parking.

434957f38c6c3c03b4fb.text: Same. I'll look at tickets tonight.

78fad7df82a1ff66ef10.text: That's fine. I just want to walk around and eat well.

366a30dcdcff543c0f34.text: There's a morning market I really want to see.

28362083185896c7e688.text: Then let's get there early on Saturday.

8c028672f0bd8ac3f38d.text: Deal. This is going to be nice.

acfb156ac9b7572380b4.text: I think so. Something about a signal problem.

6bb47a4431838388e040.text: That's the second time this week.

db8f872f446a07aaa5b6.text: Tell me about it. I was supposed to be home by seven.

6914e2306b85411562d4.text: Same here. I might just grab a coffee while we wait.

73a81118c49fddb3c343.text: There's a decent place by the ticket machines.

ad7dd01db1f6c3f92628.text: Thanks. I'll keep an eye on the board.

a3a2ef1ed01fb95bdf5c.text: If it jumps to an hour, I'm getting a cab.

1326f52c4ee329129914.text: I might join you if it comes to that.

101513f6ab9a76f80962.text: It smells amazing. Did you make the dumplings too?

48d772bb0a208746eb8f.text: Your dad did most of them this time.

7af9181f09e9fa0906d0.text: Don't look so surprised. I can cook.

527ec72a160555fec564.text: I know, I know. I just usually see you at the table, not in the kitchen.

5a9294bd35883c091851.text: It's busy, but it's okay. I might come home earlier next month.

5fb8ebeda974c930e689.text: That would be nice. Eat first. We can talk more later.

3fd7e8dde4c7ed954b4c.text: Yeah. My phone's been slowing down, and I think it's time.

d689915602b82bcea263.text: Do you care more about the camera or the battery?

95e2aa2e1bd507a5659f.text: Battery, for sure. I don't take that many photos.

93ac006004dd37200c6f.text: Then this one is a solid choice. It usually lasts a full day.

fd5442e5bdef05cf9a4d.text: That's what I need. Can I trade in the old one?

2b78973ac8efff03bdad.text: Yes. I can check the value if you have it with you.

89f517161c9710f026c9.text: I do. Let's do that first, then I'll decide.

8028bfb81d52f88ae610.text: Sounds good. Follow me over here.

ac60db55ee86e641d3eb.text: You've been carrying that camera a lot lately.

c263181bdbfc4af8d0d1.text: Yeah. I started taking photos again on weekends.

abeb8684f6a45ce8da37.text: Mostly streets and morning light. Nothing serious.

3e1c9557450913f381f5.text: I'd love to see some of them sometime.

9a1402b6a758c82dfcdb.text: Sure. They're not perfect, but I like doing it.

9d33cde92fbb429a19b0.text: That's the point, right? It doesn't have to be perfect.

727414b4f51a11e761ad.text: Exactly. It just gets me out of the house.

dd61d2b5ef0f495c363d.text: I might tag along one Saturday, if that's okay.

c3be5ac64d236175f358.text: Thanks for coming in today. Did you find the office okay?

a1cf5234e2de90c3d77f.text: Yes, it was easy. The front desk was really helpful.

b522ca29e24df0ab0c4f.text: Good. Why don't you start by telling me a little about yourself?

e0ccb1f0d3a9b565fb01.text: Sure. I've been working in product for about six years, mostly on tools for teams.

2bf2b0a667dbaf73492b.text: And what made you apply for this role?

d4639619db28eebeb7ec.text: I like the problem you're trying to solve, and I want to work closer to users.

33b7a817ac0d25a4f278.text: That's helpful. What are you hoping to learn here?

7084de9fc523e7c65503.text: I'd like to get better at working with research, and to ship things end to end.

f5c329e9131f097f207c.text: Great. Let's talk about a project you're proud of.

d602a72d61123f0f4d40.text: I think we should launch this week and fix issues later.

57033bc91adb23ecc134.text: I see why you'd want that, but I'm not sure that's a good idea.

e536edbd254d29e9529c.text: If the signup flow is confusing, we're going to lose people right away.

f8f598a3f025e81d5375.text: I have to agree with Nina. We only get one first impression.

66471d8160ca27d00868.text: Okay. So what would you change before we launch?

aeea90f492838e53c534.text: Just the first two screens. It wouldn't take more than a day.

cd2555c78e2457d67210.text: That's fair. Let's do that and aim for early next week.

a1d37bfe5dbb0412d58e.text: Thanks. I think that's the safer call.

5df2b7e34bbb9206e072.text: You don't have to talk if you don't want to. I'm just glad you came.

45f601ad0116564c4ad7.text: Thanks. I think I just needed to get out of the apartment.

d37316af01b34dedc71e.text: That makes sense. It's been a rough week.

8df52da4a9c0b480824c.text: I keep thinking I should have handled it better.

d144077a988cb19ce4c5.text: You did what you could. You don't have to be perfect in a hard moment.

260b96b66251b5536745.text: I know that in my head. It's just hard to feel it.

cb6e881c46b4b2b97d4c.text: That's okay. We can just sit here for a bit.

452542fdf6255ccd017e.text: I'd like that. Thank you for coming.

43bb7b2796f28c520f6c.text: Did you see that story about the new train line?

2ee8066c4306fddccc2f.text: I saw the headline, but I didn't read it. What's going on?

29cfeb122a47a076ce11.text: They might start building next year. It would cut my commute in half.

d43d6e17c671e23abe25.text: That would be huge for you. Do they have a real timeline?

5b30efa8ae96409b522e.text: Not really. It still has to get approved, so I'm not holding my breath.

319c496c13e2296f9115.text: Still, it's something. We've needed that for years.

c0913ca46fc939f0fa80.text: Yeah. Even if it takes longer, I'm glad they're talking about it.

aca5326a96082f886847.text: Send me the article later. I want to read it properly.

1444257e3f6416482808.text: If we do a little every day, it won't feel so heavy.

de644f92a91ad2b3ee22.text: I agree. I just never keep the plan when work gets busy.

be53b99aefa603c73e76.text: Then let's make it small on purpose. Thirty minutes, not two hours.

95d712f26b44c8ddb27c.text: That I can do. Morning or evening?

1d82951527cdc68e4d4c.text: Evening works better for me. After dinner, before I look at my phone.

b22e360308016b3f42e1.text: Okay. I'll try the same window so we can check in.

34bc55283df45f86850c.text: We don't have to report every day. Maybe just twice a week.

51dd87049c8638a4f5b8.text: That's more realistic. I like this.

2e02c2eeb22b0b4b41f1.text: Good. Let's start tonight, even if it's only ten minutes.

31a429f358b3300b490c.text: Hi, have you had a chance to look at the menu?

30a60adfcf4a9d575b1b.text: I think so. What's good tonight?

fdd1fddc271f9c0e036b.text: The roast chicken is really popular, and the soup is homemade.

3732c90b538f4a15b3cb.text: I'll go with the chicken. Can I get the vegetables instead of fries?

252ed1420773e33d41b6.text: I'll have the pasta, please. Not too spicy.

33ff173936428973c5e6.text: Just water for now. Thank you.

1588fc119fe9adaa672a.text: I'll be right back with that.

ea11ba7d4013440d157e.text: Thanks for calling. How can I help you today?

8bc792fe01c327bf0930.text: Hi. I ordered a lamp last week, but it still hasn't arrived.

4fe4a4450ae16021d51d.text: I'm sorry about that. Can I have your order number?

8608fd78a046efdd64c1.text: It's 4-8-2-1-9. I can also give you the email.

73e4337dd99ffbfac951.text: That's okay, I found it. It looks like it was delayed in transit.

d8fa2e587152ddde852e.text: Do you know when I can expect it?

dc630f31246c20170e37.text: It should arrive by Thursday. I can also send a replacement if you'd rather.

e81c5502392e886e8fae.text: Thursday is fine, as long as it's moving again.

629eebfc29e792e81018.text: It is. I'll email you the new tracking now. Sorry again.

3ad8e5e91a578954f081.text: I liked it more than I expected. The first half was a little slow.

74d4ddb633b2338a1077.text: I thought so too. But the ending really landed for me.

6345e483eaf4dae58237.text: Yeah. I didn't see that coming, and I usually guess these things.

2cba268fd58f8a2a4a87.text: The two leads were great. I believed they knew each other for years.

b2efbf7166e1f6c45c02.text: That's what got me. It felt simple, but not empty.

4f0fbc13a19b3fa120b3.text: Want to get some tea and talk about it a bit more?

173e738d9eae153dec72.text: Yes. I have a few questions I need to say out loud.

b3a08fdd9f0fde943344.text: Good. There's a place around the corner.

b82989a9ad792903de67.text: Can you believe it's been four weeks already?

8e17d14c8e3104e53c58.text: I know. It went faster than I thought.

227d1b3caa25e115359c.text: A little. I still get stuck, but I don't freeze as much.

cd815ce8da0ebc062cd6.text: That's a real change. I noticed I can follow conversations better.

7de0e6118f27d8a8060b.text: Same. I used to miss the beginning and then give up.

084b030356cbe4678ec5.text: We should keep the habit, even if we change the routine a bit.

7f6ad55c17e2dca93057.text: Agreed. Small and steady still works.

a7867cd3ca5b52e4808b.text: Good. Let's not wait for a perfect day to start the next part.

c6f1f496edf2d095b77f.text: I'm fine, it's just a bit too much.
